intro: Estonia is a parliamentary republic and one of the world's leaders in digital government.

chapters.title: Parliament and president
text: The single-chamber parliament, the Riigikogu, has 101 members and chooses the prime minister. The president is elected by parliament and has mostly ceremonial powers.

chapters.title: e-Estonia
text: In 2005 Estonia became the first country to let people vote online in a nationwide election. Its e-Residency programme lets people anywhere in the world set up an Estonian company online. Estonia is a member of NATO and the EU.

keyTerms.meaning: A digital identity Estonia offers to non-residents.
